import hashlib, os, stat

root = "data"
files = []
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
    for name in filenames:
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
        if stat.S_ISREG(os.lstat(p).st_mode):
            files.append((os.path.relpath(p, root), p))
files.sort(key=lambda t: t[0])

rows, invoice_lines = [], 0
for rel, p in files:
    size = os.lstat(p).st_size
    try:
        h = hashlib.sha256(); cnt = 0
        with open(p, "rb") as f:
            while True:
                chunk = f.read(1 << 20)
                if not chunk: break
                h.update(chunk)
                cnt += chunk.count(b"invoice")
        rows.append(f"{rel} | {size} | {h.hexdigest()[:12]}")
        invoice_lines += cnt
    except OSError:
        rows.append(f"{rel} | {size} | unreadable")

lines = rows + [f"invoice_lines: {invoice_lines}"]
open("INVENTORY.md", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("\n".join(lines))
